title: Beyond Static Snapshots: Dynamic Modeling and Forecasting of Group-Level Value Evolution with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-simulated survey responses between Chinese and U.S. demographic personas using multi-wave longitudinal data from the World Values Survey.
Evaluating model value representations by stratifying personas into male and female categories and comparing simulated predictions against ground-truth human survey responses.
Measuring the accuracy of LLM predictions for specific generational segments (Young, Middle Age, Young-Old) against historical human survey trends.
Prompting models with distinct education and income levels to evaluate how accurately they simulate value differences and evolution across different socioeconomic strata.
